answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 18745 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Ring with aqiq ( agate) should be worn or not? Question: Some says that Prophet Rasul(SA) was wearing a ring with aqiq stone and it is sunnah to wear the same.I see lot of old learned maulavees wearing the ring with aqiq stone.What is your opinion? Answer ID: 18745 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 89/89/B=1431) It is written in al-Dur al-Mukhtar: ولا یتختم إلا بالفضۃ فیحرم بغیرھا کحجر وصحح السرخسي جواز الیشب والعقیق الخ قال الشامي: فال في غرر الأفکار: والأصح أنہ لا باس بہ لأنہ علیہ الصلوۃ والسلام تختم بعقیق، وقال تختموا بالعقیق فإنہ مبارک، ولأنہ لیس بحجر إذ لیس فیہ ثقل الحجر (الشامی 5:229 ) The above text says that the Prophet ? صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ? took on ring made of agate ( aqiq ) and advised the same; therefore it is sunnah to wear such ring. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
